Stratagems.Effect: Your unit’s attacks have: [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle]. Or: [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

Stratagems.Name: POINT-BLANK BRUTALITY
Stratagems.When: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged TACTICUS unit is selected to shoot.
Stratagems.Effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [Blast] attacks) have: [Close-Quarters]. [Ignores Cover].

Enhancements.Name: Cyber-familiar
Enhancements.Description: Tacticus model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly Adeptus Astartes INFANTRY units. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

Enhancements.Name: Tempered in Battle (Aura)
Enhancements.Description: Tacticus model only. Friendly Adeptus Astartes units within 6" of this model can re-roll leadership rolls.

Rule.Title: Shadow Masters
Rule.Text:
When a Phobos or Scout Squad unit has shot:
▪ Those attacks do not prevent that unit from being hidden
▪ Or: That unit can make a normal move of up to D6". That unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

Stratagems.Name: STRIKE FROM THE SHADOWS
Stratagems.When: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly hidden PHOBOS unit is selected to attack.
Stratagems.Effect: Your unit’s attacks have: +1 S. [Lethal Hits].

Stratagems.Name: MORTIS SNARES
Stratagems.When: End of your Movement phase.
Stratagems.Target: One friendly unengaged PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit.
Stratagems.Effect: If your unit is controlling an objective, that objective is snared. While an objective is snared, when an enemy unit ends a move within range of that objective, roll one D6: On a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D6 mortal wounds. That objective is no longer snared.

Stratagems.Name: TACTICAL WITHDRAWAL
Stratagems.When: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Stratagems.Target: One friendly unengaged PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit.
Stratagems.Effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

Enhancements.Name: Execute and Redeploy
Enhancements.Description: Phobos model only. In your shooting phase, after this unit has shot, if this unit is unengaged, this unit can make a normal move of up to 6". If it does, this unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

Enhancements.Name: Venator Omni-auspex
Enhancements.Description:
Phobos model only. This unit's attacks that target a hidden unit can:
▪ Re-roll wound rolls of 1
▪ Or: If the assault doctrine is active for this unit, re-roll wound rolls of 1 and 2

Rule.Title: Vanguard Ambushers
Rule.Text: At the end of your Movement phase, if a friendly Phobos unit is hidden, that unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1 until the end of the turn.

Stratagems.Name: STRIKE FROM THE SHADOWS
Stratagems.When: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly hidden PHOBOS unit is selected to attack.
Stratagems.Effect: Your unit’s attacks have: +1 S. [Lethal Hits].

Stratagems.Name: TRANSHUMAN REACTIONS
Stratagems.When: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged PHOBOS unit.
Stratagems.Effect: Your unit can make a normal move of: Up to D6". Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, up to 6".

Stratagems.Name: UMBRAL EVASION
Stratagems.When: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly PHOBOS unit.
Stratagems.Effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.

Enhancements.Name: Seal of Shrouding
Enhancements.Description: Phobos model only. Enemy units cannot target this unit with snap shooting attacks.

Enhancements.Name: Venator Omni-auspex
Enhancements.Description:
Phobos model only. This unit's attacks that target a hidden unit can:
▪ Re-roll wound rolls of 1
▪ Or: If the assault doctrine is active for this unit, re-roll wound rolls of 1-2

Rule.Title: Walking Fortress
Rule.Text:
In a turn a friendly Gravis unit made a normal move, that unit's ranged attacks:
▪ Do not have [Heavy]
▪ Have +1 to hit rolls

Stratagems.Name: ANNIHILATING FORCE
Stratagems.When: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit is selected to attack.
Stratagems.Effect: Your unit’s attacks have [Lethal Hits].

Stratagems.Name: PURGATION PUSH
Stratagems.When: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit has shot.
Stratagems.Effect: If your unit is unengaged, your unit can make a normal move of up to 5", and must end that move within range of an objective. Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge or embark within a TRANSPORT until the end of the turn.

Stratagems.Name: ARMOURED IMPACT
Stratagems.When: Your Charge phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit ends a charge move.
Stratagems.Effect: When your unit ends a charge move, you can select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. If you do, roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit: For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

Enhancements.Name: Indefatigable Fortitude
Enhancements.Description: Gravis model only. Attacks that target this unit with a S greater than this unit's T have -1 to wound rolls.

Enhancements.Name: Relentless Advance
Enhancements.Description: Gravis model only. This unit has Scouts 5"

Rule.Title: Indomitable Defence
Rule.Text: While a friendly Gravis unit is within range of an objective, attacks that target that unit with a S greater than that unit's T have -1 to wound rolls

Stratagems.Name: ANNIHILATING FORCE
Stratagems.When: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit is selected to attack.
Stratagems.Effect: Your unit’s attacks have [Lethal Hits].

Stratagems.Name: STAND UNYIELDING
Stratagems.When: End of your Movement phase.
Stratagems.Effect: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

Stratagems.Name: SUPPRESSION VOLLEYS
Stratagems.When: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit has shot.
Stratagems.Effect: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

Enhancements.Name: Immovable Conquerors (Upgrade)
Enhancements.Description: Gravis unit only. This unit has +1 OC

Enhancements.Name: Narthecis Gauntlet
Enhancements.Description: Apothecary Biologis model only. In your Command phase, this unit heals D3+1 wounds.

Rule.Title: Enduring Vengeance
Rule.Text: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Dreadnought units can re-roll hit rolls of 1

Stratagems.Name: ADAMANTINE TERROR
Stratagems.When: Start of the Fight phase.
Stratagems.Effect: Each enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

Stratagems.Name: MERCY IS WEAKNESS
Stratagems.When: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to attack.
Stratagems.Effect: Your unit’s attacks have: [lethal hits]. Or: [Sustained Hits 1].

Stratagems.Name: UPSTOPPABLE ADVANCE
Stratagems.When: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to move or declares a charge.
Stratagems.Effect: Your unit has MOBILE.

Enhancements.Name: Artificer Sarcophagus (Upgrade)
Enhancements.Description: Dreadnought unit only. Attacks that target this unit have -1D

Enhancements.Name: Venerable Champion (Aura) (Upgrade)
Enhancements.Description: Dreadnought unit only. While a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit is within 6" of this unit, that unit's attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1

Rule.Title: Combined Deployment
Rule.Text:
In your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Transport unit has shot, you can select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is assailed until the end of the turn.
▪ While a unit is assailed, when an Adeptus Astartes unit that disembarked this turn targets that unit, those attacks have [Sustained Hits 1]

Stratagems.Name: AGGRESSIVE DISEMBARKATION
Stratagems.When: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within a TRANSPORT is selected to move.
Stratagems.Effect: While making that move, each model in your unit can be set up within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT. This allows you to set up your unit within the set-up distance of your TRANSPORT, instead of wholly within that distance.

Stratagems.Name: DUTY IS NEVER DONE
Stratagems.When: End of the Fight phase.
Stratagems.Target: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit that was eligible to fight this phase, is wholly within 6" of a friendly TRANSPORT unit, and is eligible to embark within that TRANSPORT unit.
Stratagems.Effect: Your unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.

Stratagems.Name: STORM AND SECURE
Stratagems.When: End of your Movement phase.
Stratagems.Target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit that has an ADEPTUS ASTARTES BATTLELINE unit embarked within it.
Stratagems.Effect: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

Enhancements.Name: Linebreaker Onslaught
Enhancements.Description:
Adeptus Astartes Infantry model only. If this unit disembarked this turn:
▪ This unit can re-roll charge rolls
▪ Enemy units cannot target this unit with snap shooting attacks.

Enhancements.Name: Damocles-class Uplink
Enhancements.Description: Captain model only. In your Movement phase, if this unit is embarked within a Transport unit, you can select one friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit within 6" of that Transport unit and select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for that Infantry unit.

Rule.Title: Mission Tactics
Rule.Text:
Friendly KILL TEAM units with this ability have the following abilities:


Furor Tactics: If the devastator doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].


Malleus Tactics: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks have [LETHAL HITS].


Purgatus Tactics: If the assault doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks that target an enemy unit within 9" of this unit have [PRECISION].


DEATHWATCH ALLIES


You can include Deathwatch units in your army, even though they do not have the same Chapter faction keyword as other units in your army. The combined points value of such units cannot exceed 500 points.


When mustering your army, unless otherwise stated, you cannot select a Deathwatch model to be your Warlord. In addition Kill Team units can only contain enhancements taken from this detachment.

Stratagems.Name: KRAKEN ROUNDS
Stratagems.When: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.
Stratagems.Effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have: Have +6" R. Have +1 S.

Stratagems.Name: DRAGONFIRE ROUNDS
Stratagems.When: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.
Stratagems.Effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks: Can re-roll wound rolls of 1. Have [IGNORES COVER].

Stratagems.Name: HELLFIRE ROUNDS
Stratagems.When: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.
Stratagems.Effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] attacks) have [ANTI-non-VEHICLE 4+].

Stratagems.Name: BLACKSTAR EXTRACTION
Stratagems.When: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Stratagems.Target: One friendly unengaged KILL TEAM unit.
Stratagems.Effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

Enhancements.Name: Beacon Angelis
Enhancements.Description:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. If this unit is a Kill Team unit, this unit has:

▪ Deep Strike.
▪ When you target this unit with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem, that use is -1CP.

ArmyRules.Title: Combat Doctrines
ArmyRules.Text:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one combat doctrine listed below. If you do, that combat doctrine is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command phase.

**Assault Doctrine**

When this unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

**Devastator Doctrine**

This unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

**Tactical Doctrine**

When this unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot and eligible to declare a charge.
Unless otherwise stated:

- You can only select each combat doctrine once per battle.
- Only one combat doctrine can be active for each unit. If a rule makes a combat doctrine active for a unit, any combat doctrine previously active for that unit is no longer active for that unit.

ArmyRules.Title: Transhuman Strategist
ArmyRules.Text: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

ArmyRules.Title: Librarius
ArmyRules.Text:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER units with this ability have a psyker level of 1 or higher, specified in that unit’s abilities. Each psychic ability has a psychic level of 1 or higher, specified in that ability’s name.

In a battle round, a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER unit can use a number of psychic abilities whose total psychic level does not exceed that PSYKER unit’s psyker level.

Example: In a battle round, a psyker level 3 PSYKER unit could use three psychic level 1 abilities, or one psychic level 1 ability and one psychic level 2 ability, or one psychic level 3 ability.

**Space Marine Chapters**

If an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit has a second Faction keyword on its datasheet, that Faction keyword is the name of that unit’s Chapter. For example, Marneus Calgar has both the ADEPTUS ASTARTES and ULTRAMARINES Faction keywords,and is therefore from the Ultramarines Chapter.

You cannot include units from more than one Chapter in your army.

ArmyRules.Title: Special Move Types
ArmyRules.Text:
The following are special move types that certain or all of your units are eligible to make.

SHOCK DISEMBARK MOVE

SET-UP DISTANCE: 3"

ELIGIBLE IF:

- Embarked within a TRANSPORT on the battlefield
- Did not embark within that TRANSPORT this phase

EFFECT: Set up as described in Set Up (03.02).

WHILE MOVING: Set up each model wholly within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT.

AFTER MOVING: Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

ASSAULT DISEMBARK MOVE

SET-UP DISTANCE: 3"

ELIGIBLE IF:

- Embarked within a TRANSPORT on the battlefield
- Did not embark within that TRANSPORT this phase
- That TRANSPORT has not made an advance/fall-back move this phase

EFFECT: Set up as described in Set Up (03.02).

WHILE MOVING: Set up each model wholly within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT.
